Name: Zechariah, Son of Meshelemiah
Summary: Firstborn son of Meshelemiah the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:2; 1 Chronicles 9:21: Firstborn son of Meshelemiah the porter.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zechariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
